mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS activeUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE status = 'SUSPENDED' AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS suspendedUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS deletedUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetings) AS totalMeetings, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetings WHERE status IN ('INPUT_OPEN', 'VOTING')) AS ongoingMeetings, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_messages) AS totalChatMessages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meeting_candidates WHERE is_active = TRUE) AS totalCandidates, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_votes) AS totalVotes
SELECT user_id AS userId, email, nickname, role, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, user_id DESC LIMIT #{size}

SELECT m.meeting_id AS meetingId, m.title, m.status, u.nickname AS hostNickname, m.created_at AS createdAt FROM meetings m JOIN users u ON u.user_id = m.host_user_id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.meeting_id DESC LIMIT #{size}
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM users WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM meetings WHERE created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date
